metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds a short page before noon, the doorway in the frost, and a memo after you came in.

yesterday: You were at home while Titus played at two.
One line in the fifth act has a cross in the margin.
The close was hard frost. One window was lit in Crosby Place. A cat's prints were the only others.
You tried a line aloud and it sounded like a proclamation. You laughed at it, and you went in.
